tasks.subject: Slice 1: Security headers (helmet)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add HTTP security headers.
**Steps:** npm i helmet; app.use(helmet()) in src/main.ts before routes (minimal defaults, JSON API — no CSP surface). CORS default '*' already shipped (#27); explicit-origin requirement documented in Slice 6 runbook, no code change.
**Acceptance:** curl -I /health shows x-content-type-options:nosniff, HSTS, x-dns-prefetch-control.
**Verify:** curl -I http://localhost:3000/health ; npm run lint/build/test green.
**Reviewers:** code-reviewer, api-reviewer, docs-maintainer.

tasks.subject: Slice 2: Rate limiting (throttler)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Rate-limit login/signup/AI to stop brute force + AI abuse.
**Steps:** npm i @nestjs/throttler (+ @nest-lab/throttler-storage-redis ioredis, back with existing REDIS_* config, in-memory fallback when Redis unset — mirror CONTEXT_GATHERER/LLM_PLANNER presence-of-env factory). app.module.ts: ThrottlerModule.forRootAsync (default 100/60s) + ThrottlerGuard as APP_GUARD. @Throttle tight on auth login/register (~5/min) and AI endpoints (suggestions.controller generate, planning-jobs.controller submit). New optional env THROTTLE_TTL/THROTTLE_LIMIT in env.validation.ts + .env.example.
**Acceptance:** brute-force POST /auth/login returns 429 after cap; single request still 200/201.
**Verify:** unit test guard wiring; e2e/manual loop → 429.
**Reviewers:** code-reviewer, api-reviewer, docs-maintainer. Shares main.ts/app.module.ts with Slices 1,3 → serialize.

tasks.subject: Slice 3: Secret + exposure hardening
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Enforce strong JWT secret, hide Swagger in prod, drop source maps.
**Steps:** env.validation.ts add @MinLength(32) to JWT_SECRET (keep @IsNotEmpty) + spec test (mirror WS_CORS_ORIGIN/CORS_ORIGIN style) + .env.example 'min 32 chars' comment. main.ts wrap SwaggerModule.setup in if(config.get('NODE_ENV')!=='production'). tsconfig: omit .map from prod build (sourceMap:false in build config or strip dist/**/*.map).
**Acceptance:** NODE_ENV=production → GET /docs 404; dev → 200; 10-char JWT_SECRET → boot validation error; dist has no .map.
**Verify:** boot both env values; npm run build inspect dist.
**Reviewers:** code-reviewer, api-reviewer, docs-maintainer, tooling-reviewer(if scripts). Shares main.ts with Slice 2.

tasks.subject: Slice 4: Dependency vulns
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Clear 2 HIGH npm audit findings (multer DoS via @nestjs/platform-express).
**Steps:** npm audit fix; if needed take minimal semver-compatible @nestjs/platform-express bump. No direct multer use (no upload surface) → low breakage risk. Re-run lint/build/test/e2e.
**Acceptance:** npm audit --omit=dev reports 0 high/critical; full suite green.
**Verify:** npm audit --omit=dev.
**Reviewers:** code-reviewer, api-reviewer, devops. Independent — can run anytime.

tasks.subject: Slice 5: Security audit log
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Persist a security audit trail. PG clean-architecture slice via /new-module audit --db pg (confirm placement w/ db-mentor — relational, not a Mongo collection).
**Steps:** Update docs/database-schema.md + D2 diagram FIRST: audit_logs (id, user_id nullable FK→users ON DELETE SET NULL, action string, metadata jsonb, ip nullable, created_at; index user_id + created_at). Migration CreateAuditLogs. Domain AuditLog entity + AuditLogRepository interface; application RecordAuditEvent use-case; infra TypeORM entity + repo. Write-only, NO controller (never serialized — 'no public controller' like prompts). Emit via EventEmitter2 from LoginUseCase (success + failure), connector revoke use-case, suggestion accept/reject use-case. Single AuditListener (presentation) sole subscriber, swallows own errors (mirror GamificationListener swallow-and-log).
**Acceptance:** login writes audit_logs row action='auth.login'; bad password → 'auth.login_failed'; revoke → 'connector.revoked'. Migration up/down clean.
**Verify:** unit tests use-case+listener; e2e row assertions.
**Reviewers:** code-reviewer, api-reviewer, db-mentor, docs-maintainer. Largest slice.

tasks.subject: Slice 6: Ops runbook + supply-chain CI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Operational security runbook + supply-chain CI.
**Steps:** docs/security.md (docs-maintainer): monitoring/alerting (5xx rate, auth.login_failed spikes from audit log, throttle 429s, deploy update_failed; Render/Atlas/Upstash/CloudAMQP dashboards); backup/restore (Render Postgres PITR, Atlas M0 posture + restore drill, M0 backup limits); deploy security checklist (explicit CORS_ORIGIN/WS_CORS_ORIGIN per env not '*', 32+ char unique JWT_SECRET per env, all COMPOSIO_*/RABBITMQ_URL preset before first deploy per 2026-07 outage, DB least-privilege role no SUPERUSER/DDL); SSRF note (CONTEXT_ENGINE_URL operator-set never user-supplied); prompt-injection note (verify Anthropic calls keep user content in user role not concatenated into system prompt, LLM output persisted as data never executed — spot-check anthropic-suggestion-generator.ts / anthropic-llm-planner.ts, fold small fix in if violated). .github (devops): dependabot.yml weekly npm; npm audit --audit-level=high step in ci.yml.
**Acceptance:** runbook covers 43,44,23,39,7,41,27; dependabot + audit CI live.
**Verify:** actionlint on ci.yml; render runbook.
**Reviewers:** docs-maintainer, devops, tooling-reviewer. Depends on Slice 5 (references audit log) + Slice 2 (references 429s) → last.
